title: A Horizon for the Escarpment
author: Bram Ravensworth
blurb: Isandro Montrose, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
